newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo Beogradska banka finalises $50 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Yugo Beogradska banka finalises $50 mln bond issue.

text.p: Yugoslavia's largest banking group Beogradska Banka Group said on Thursday it finalised a $50 million bond issue maturing 2000 through London-based ANZ Investment Bank.
No further details were immediately available, except that the deal was signed on July 2.

"Funds raised through the bond issue are immediately disposable and will be used by Beogradska banka clients for maintaing their current hard currency liquidity and financing exports," the bank said in a press release.
It was the first international fund-raising transaction through a bond issue after more than ten years, the bank said in its statement.

"Beogradska Banka Group transaction marks Yugoslavia's successful return to international capital markets and demonstrates investor confidence in Yugoslavia's economic revival," the statement quoted the group's pesident Borka Vucic as saying. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 311 4254
